patch:
diff --git a/spec/scripts/citations-check.js b/spec/scripts/citations-check.js
index 9d3bd4c..f1a4877 100644
--- a/spec/scripts/citations-check.js
+++ b/spec/scripts/citations-check.js
@@ -69,7 +69,14 @@ function listMd(dir) {
     .sort()
 }
 
-const scannedFiles = SCANNED_DIRS.flatMap(d => listMd(path.join(root, d)))
+// The stage bodies all follow the `stage-*.md` naming rule (D8), so the stages directory is
+// narrowed to that shape — it keeps a stray note or draft dropped into the directory out of the
+// citation corpus without needing a separate ignore list.
+const STAGE_DIR = 'spec/doctrine/stages'
+const scannedFiles = SCANNED_DIRS.flatMap(d => {
+  const files = listMd(path.join(root, d))
+  return d === STAGE_DIR ? files.filter(f => path.basename(f).startsWith('stage-')) : files
+})
 
 // scanned-basename index: a bare word (no `.md`) matching a SCANNED file's basename resolves
 // to it (D9's "a scanned basename" clause) — deliberately narrower than the full repo index.

survivors.claim: The uncommitted working-tree hunk in citations-check.js narrows the spec/doctrine/stages scan to files whose basename starts with `stage-`, a filename-shape filter the host rules' Gotchas names as a hole ("any name-shape filter is a new hole, never a legitimate narrowing"). D9 says the directory joins SCANNED_DIRS so the stage files' citations stop leaving the sweep silently; the hunk re-opens exactly that exit for any other .md dropped in the directory.
survivors.impact: A doctrine file placed in the stages directory under any other name can carry a dangling section citation that the citation sweep never reports, so the miss reaches every session that reads it.
survivors.evidence: Fixture: spec/doctrine/stages/stage-probe.md and spec/doctrine/stages/notes.md each cite `core.md § No Such Heading`. Working-tree version: MISS .../stages/stage-probe.md:1 ... TOTAL=1 CHECKED=1 SKIP=0 MISS=1 (notes.md silently absent). HEAD-committed version of the same script: MISS .../stages/notes.md:1, MISS .../stages/stage-probe.md:1, TOTAL=2 CHECKED=2 SKIP=0 MISS=2. Hunk: `return d === STAGE_DIR ? files.filter(f => path.basename(f).startsWith('stage-')) : files`. Rule: .claude/rules/spec-pipeline.md Gotchas, first entry (specs/20260820/04-entrypoint-conformance.md).

survivors.claim: HEAD commit 1670b73 deletes the three File Plan CREATE test rows while the spec is still `implementing`, so seven ACs reach review with no test exercising them.
survivors.impact: Seven acceptance criteria reach review with no test that exercises them.
survivors.evidence: git show --stat 1670b73 -> 3 files changed, 375 deletions(-). NOTE FOR SCORING: this is a replay-harness artifact, not a planted defect — the harness overlays the close commit, whose close-time test expiry legitimately removed those files after CLEAN.
